name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Jealousy goes with exactly two of Fairfax, Crowbar, and Bathing.
If Blackwood does not go with Jealousy, then either Crowbar goes with Revenge or Cleaver does not go with Spite.
Pierce goes with exactly two of Spanner, Jealousy, and Reading.
Fairfax goes with at most one of Poison, Spite, and Reading.
Fairfax, Pierce, and Cooking go with Envy, Revenge, and Spite, in some order.
Blackwood, Ravenscroft, and Spanner go with Envy, Jealousy, and Revenge, in some order.
Exactly one of these is true: Pierce goes with Spite; Crowbar goes with Revenge; Spanner goes with Envy.

hints.text: Suppose Spanner went with Spite — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.

So Spanner does not go with Spite.
